alex: hey IT — my new monitor arm arrived but the screen wobbles and briefly flickers when I adjust it. set up at desk 4C. using CalDigit TS4 dock via USB-C. any quick checks i should try before i open a ticket? :confused:

it_julie: welcome, alex :wave: do you mean the arm physically wobbles or the image flickers? both can happen. quick checklist: tighten the VESA screws, make sure the arm clamp is fully seated to the desk, and try connecting the monitor directly to your laptop to rule out the dock. can you share a photo and confirm the monitor model + cable type (DP/HDMI/USB-C)?

alex: thanks — both. the arm is a bit loose and when i move the monitor the image blips. ticket created: TKT-4785. photo: https://files.redwood/example.jpg (camera phone). monitor is Dell U2723Q, cable is DisplayPort to USB-C (from dock). also happens right after waking from sleep. here's a short kernel log when it flickered:

```
[  120.345678] usb 3-2: new SuperSpeed device number 7 using xhci_hcd
[  121.012345] DisplayPort: link lost, retiming
[  121.015678] drm: connector DP-1: link status changed
```

it_julie: good details. sounds like a connectivity drop between dock and monitor. two things to triage: 1) try a different cable (swap to HDMI if you have one) and 2) test the monitor directly attached to laptop (bypass dock) for a few hours to see if the flicker returns. if it stabilizes plugged direct -> dock is likely the culprit. if still flaky -> monitor/arm hardware. if you can, loosen/tighten the VESA screws once (don’t over-torque). i'll queue TKT-4785 for hardware triage but tagging facilities in case arm needs replacement.

sam: FYI facilities here — Ergotron LX arms sometimes have the tilt pivot a bit loose from shipping. if the bolt at the pivot is loose, that’ll cause wobble. can tighten with 5mm hex and add a nylon washer. if alex prefers we can swap the arm next-day. @ella can coordinate pickup/shipment.

ella: @sam noted. logistics can do next-day swap. alex — what's the best time for a desk swap window? we usually aim 10–4. we’ll bring a replacement arm + spare DP cable. please confirm desk location (building/wing/4C).

it-bot: Ticket TKT-4785 status updated: Technician assigned — scheduled pickup for 2024-08-22 11:00 local.

alex: thanks everyone — 4C is Building B, East wing. 11:00 works. temporary workaround: i'll connect monitor directly to laptop for calls and set display sleep to never while i'm at desk. appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:
